completion:
Interrogate the building for a BLD.
3. Correspond with the relevant potential check finding.

## Tips for performing the check

- Expect this to be a moving target.
- Reach out to BDS for a diagnosis in areas of uncertainty.

---

If the building hasn't received an assessment message of the quick pass or 'to imput', the building won't have an assessment in the system. If the passing check belongs to a type that occurs every year, like a Flood, building assessments receive a failing check finding if shelling occurs. The check can adjust the assessments if the type that fails yearly. If your summary complements of recording recognition are found to be faulty, a record will be subsidized before your next check document. We've taken an early start at learning the feedback cycle timeframes.

---

If a building hasn't had this inspection, the inspection record will show it was requested but not performed by spray contact.
